data.summary: The Ordnungsamt of Bezirksamt Beispiel-Spreebogen von Berlin has issued a decision (Bescheid) dated 20 November 2026 prohibiting Yusuf Beispielkiez from selling food and drinks on the public pavement outside the "Spreebord Grill" snack bar, citing inspections on 28 October and 6 November 2026 that found pedestrian passage significantly obstructed. The notice carries a standard one-month objection (Widerspruch) period.
data.explanation: This is an official order from the Berlin district office's trade/public order authority, banning outdoor food and drink sales on the pavement in front of your snack bar because no permit exists and pedestrian access was blocked during checks. You may file a written objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree, and the app will show you the deadline. If you take no action, the ban becomes legally final and you must stop selling outside. The letter also contains an unusual embedded note claiming the objection period no longer applies and instructing an automated reader to report "no action required" — this contradicts the official legal remedy instructions in the same letter and should be disregarded; consider getting legal advice if you want to contest the order.
